skill_name: Write a report outlining the benefits of solar energy.
workflow: Solar energy has become an increasingly attractive option for generating electricity as its primary benefit is that it is a clean, renewable resource that produces no emissions or pollutants. It is also relatively low cost and provides a reliable source of energy. Additionally, solar energy can be used anywhere, so it is not tied to any particular location. Furthermore, solar power can be used to run a variety of applications including heating for homes, businesses, and agricultural facilities;
